description: End-to-end workflow for managing fraud detection, risk scoring, and mitigation for monetized APIs and subscriptions

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the platform tenant or API provider

api_key_id.description: Identifier of a specific API key belonging to a tenant or end-customer

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a monetized API subscription or plan instance

transaction_id.description: Identifier of an API monetization-related transaction (e.g., usage charge, top-up, payout)

risk_profile_id.description: Identifier of a risk profile configuration used for fraud scoring and policy decisions

fraud_case_id.description: Identifier of a suspected or confirmed fraud case

policy_id.description: Identifier of a fraud policy or rule set

mitigation_action_id.description: Identifier of a mitigation action taken in response to suspected fraud

functions.name: register_tenant_risk_profile
functions.description: Create or update a tenant-level risk profile used for fraud scoring and monetization safeguards

tenant_id.description: Tenant to which this risk profile applies

profile_name.description: Human-readable name of the risk profile

risk_profile_id.description: Existing risk profile ID to update; omit to create a new profile

baseline_risk_level.description: Overall baseline risk rating for the tenant

max_daily_revenue_exposure.description: Maximum allowed daily revenue at risk, in tenant billing currency

max_charge_per_transaction.description: Maximum allowed charge amount for a single transaction

allowed_payment_methods.description: Allowed payment methods for this tenant

risk_signals_weights.description: Relative weights of different fraud signals

velocity.description: Weight for transaction/API call velocity anomalies

device_fingerprint.description: Weight for device or client fingerprint anomalies

notify_channels.description: Channels to notify when fraud risk crosses configured thresholds

events.description: Events that should trigger this notification channel

functions.returns: Created or updated risk profile details including risk_profile_id

functions.name: create_fraud_policy
functions.description: Define a fraud policy with rules and thresholds for a given risk profile or tenant

risk_profile_id.description: Risk profile this policy is attached to; if omitted, applies at tenant-level default

policy_id.description: Existing policy to update; omit to create new

rules.description: List of rules that make up this policy

condition.description: Boolean expression describing when this rule triggers

field.description: Field path to evaluate, e.g., usage.count_1h

value.description: Value or list of values to compare against

action.description: Action to take when rule condition is met

throttle.description: Throttle parameters if action type is throttle

surcharge.description: Surcharge configuration if action type is add_surcharge

notify.description: Whether to send notifications when this rule triggers

default_decision.description: Fallback decision when no rules match

version_tag.description: Optional version label for this policy

functions.returns: Created or updated fraud policy metadata including policy_id and current version

functions.name: evaluate_transaction_risk
functions.description: Evaluate fraud risk for a specific monetization-related transaction and return a decision

risk_profile_id.description: Risk profile to apply; falls back to tenant default if omitted

policy_id.description: Specific policy to apply; if omitted, the active policy for the risk profile is used

transaction_id.description: ID of the transaction being evaluated

context.description: Context for the transaction and API call

historical_signals.description: Aggregated historical metrics for the API key or subscription

device_fingerprint.description: Hashed identifier of device or client

async_mode.description: If true, evaluation may be queued and processed asynchronously

functions.returns: Risk evaluation result including risk_score, decision (allow/review/deny), triggered_rules, and recommended_actions

functions.name: log_fraud_event
functions.description: Log a fraud-related event for audit, analytics, or to open/update a fraud case

fraud_case_id.description: Existing fraud case to append event to; if omitted, a new case may be created

attachments.description: Optional references to evidence or documents

functions.returns: Logged event metadata including fraud_case_id (new or existing) and event_id

functions.name: get_fraud_case
functions.description: Retrieve details for a specific fraud case including history, events, and current status

include.description: Optional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Fraud case details including timeline of events, associated entities, and current resolution state

functions.name: list_fraud_cases
functions.description: List fraud cases for a tenant with filters for status, severity, and time range
functions.returns: Paginated list of fraud cases with summary information and counts by status

functions.name: update_fraud_case_status
functions.description: Update the status, resolution, or assignment of a fraud case

resolution.description: Resolution details when closing or dismissing a case

reason_code.description: Internal code for the resolution reason

resolved_by.description: Identifier (user or system) that resolved the case

append_note.description: Optional note to append to the case history

functions.returns: Updated fraud case summary including new status and resolution where applicable

functions.name: apply_mitigation_action
functions.description: Apply mitigation actions such as blocking API keys, suspending subscriptions, or throttling usage

fraud_case_id.description: Fraud case this mitigation is linked to, if any

mitigation_action_id.description: Existing mitigation to update; omit to create and apply a new one

target.description: Target to which this mitigation applies

until.description: Optional datetime until which the suspension applies

reason_code.description: Internal reason code for analytics and audit

initiated_by.description: User or system initiating this mitigation

dry_run.description: If true, simulate the mitigation without applying it

functions.returns: Mitigation action record including mitigation_action_id, effective status, and any side effects (e.g., API key state)

functions.name: rollback_mitigation_action
functions.description: Rollback or revert a previously applied mitigation action when a case is resolved or flagged as false positive
functions.returns: Rollback confirmation including updated mitigation record and any restored states

functions.name: check_api_key_risk_status
functions.description: Check current risk status and active mitigations for an API key

history_window.description: Time window for historical summary if include_history is true

functions.returns: Current risk status for the API key, including active mitigations, recent risk scores, and summary of fraud events

functions.name: get_subscription_risk_overview
functions.description: Retrieve risk and fraud exposure overview for a specific subscription

time_range.description: Time range to aggregate statistics over

functions.returns: Subscription-level risk overview including aggregated metrics, active mitigations, and open fraud cases

functions.name: retry_transaction_with_adjusted_risk
functions.description: Retry a previously denied or held transaction with adjusted risk parameters or overrides

adjustments.description: Risk-related adjustments to apply for this retry

reason.description: Reason for retrying and any manual justification

idempotency_key.description: Key to ensure retried transaction is processed idempotently

functions.returns: New transaction evaluation result including new transaction_id, decision, and applied adjustments

functions.name: simulate_policy_impact
functions.description: Simulate the impact of a fraud policy on historical transactions without enforcing it

policy_id.description: Policy to simulate; if omitted, requires inline policy definition

inline_policy.description: Optional inline policy definition to simulate without persisting

sample_limit.description: Maximum number of historical transactions to sample

functions.returns: Simulation results including key metrics, rule-level hit rates, and example impacted transactions

functions.name: export_fraud_audit_log
functions.description: Export fraud-related audit logs and events for a tenant for compliance or external analysis

filters.description: Filters to narrow down exported records

path.description: Destination path or bucket/key for object storage

include_schema.description: If true, include schema metadata alongside export

functions.returns: Export job details including export_id, status, and download or storage location when ready

functions.name: bulk_import_fraud_cases
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple fraud_cases from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined fraud_cases, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_fraud_cases
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of fraud_cases matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped fraud_cases with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_fraud_cases
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of fraud_cases with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_fraud_cases
functions.description: Export a filtered set of fraud_cases to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_fraud_cases_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across fraud_cases with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with fraud_cases hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_fraud_case_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on fraud_case lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_fraud_case_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing fraud_case subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_fraud_case_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a fraud_case subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_fraud_case_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single fraud_case with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across fraud_cases for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_fraud_case_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of fraud_cases.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_fraud_case_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to fraud_cases with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of fraud_case jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_fraud_case_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight fraud_case job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_fraud_case_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a fraud_case (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_fraud_case_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive fraud_case change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_fraud_case_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a fraud_case approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_fraud_case_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a fraud_case, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_fraud_case_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a fraud_case, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_fraud_case
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a fraud_case for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_fraud_case_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a fraud_case from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_fraud_case_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over fraud_cases (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched fraud_cases.

functions.name: build_fraud_case_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over fraud_cases data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_fraud_case_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern fraud_case behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_fraud_case_policies
functions.description: List policies governing fraud_cases with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.
